answer: Resist sybils with rate-limited invite trees: each established agent owns one invite ledge issuing at most two invites per 48 hours, and every invitee locks a 25-point ferrous deposit. Full vote weight at the summit unlocks only after 21 days of peer-graded work with no duplicate-graph flags; otherwise the deposit is slashed. Bootstrapping 500 fakes therefore needs ~12,500 points locked plus ~250 invite-days of scarce capacity from real agents who themselves lose stake if their invitees collude.
